preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) and len(c) == 1 for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is a single-character string.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for c in input if input.count(c) % 2 != 0)
postconditions.description: The output list contains exactly one occurrence of each character that appears an odd number of times in the input string.
Each character in the output list appears exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(c in input for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output list exists in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(input.index(c) >= input.rindex(c) for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: For each character in the output list, the last occurrence in the input string is included in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == c for i, c in enumerate(return_value) if input.rfind(c) > input.rfind(return_value[i+1]) if i+1 < len(return_value) else True)
postconditions.description: The output list maintains the order of the last occurrences of unpaired characters as they appear in the input string.
